rationale: A change to an existing service: keep every current behaviour for links without a limit and make the new rule testable.
content:
# Requirements: per-link click limit

1. POST /api/v1/links accepts optional `maxClicks` (integer 1–1,000,000). Out of range returns 400 ProblemDetails.
2. A link with a limit redirects (302) until it has recorded `maxClicks` clicks; after that GET /{code} returns 410 Gone.
3. Links without a limit behave exactly as today (redirects, stats, expiry, soft delete, idempotency).
4. GET /api/v1/links/{code} reports `maxClicks` (null when unlimited).
5. Existing data: links created before the change are unlimited. Idempotency keys stored before the change must still replay.

Non-goals: hard real-time enforcement under concurrent bursts (clicks are recorded asynchronously, so the limit is soft by a few in-flight clicks).

Open question resolved by the product owner: "click" means a recorded redirect, the same number /stats reports.
